quiz.question: If you receive an unreasonably high electricity bill and submit a written objection on the 10th day, what immediate legal protection do you have regarding your power supply?
options: The DISCOM must disconnect power until the dispute is resolved.
The DISCOM cannot disconnect your power while the dispute is pending.
Your power can be disconnected unless you pay 50 percent of the disputed amount.
You must wait 30 days before the DISCOM is prohibited from disconnecting supply.
quiz.explanation: Submitting a written objection within 15 days of receiving a bill prevents the DISCOM from disconnecting your power while the dispute is pending. Additionally, the DISCOM is required to respond to your objection within 7 days.
